chunks: From him, from Ya'qub, from Ibn Abi Najran, from one who narrated it from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"When a man has intercourse with his female slave, and then intends to have intercourse with the other (slave), he must perform wudu."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on wudu for a man having intercourse with multiple female slaves?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the ruling of *wudu* (ablution) as a recommended or obligatory act between successive acts of intercourse with female slaves, reflecting the juristic view of the time. It highlights the distinction in purity requirements for masters engaging with their concubines compared to their wives, a topic of discussion among Shia scholars regarding whether this *wudu* is for prayer or simply a ritual cleansing. The narration underscores the practical application of ritual purity in the domestic sphere during the early Islamic period.
